what_works: A single saturated red (#D70321) carries the entire site — every hero, every CTA, every accent. The wordmark wraps the page like packaging. Translates directly to a painter or exterminator with a one-color brand identity who wants the page to feel like a product, not a service.
what_does_not_translate: The Nuxt/GSAP animated product reveals on listing pages need a dev — copy the monochrome saturation and the wrapped wordmark, drop the animation layer.
type_observations: One condensed display grotesk at 'banner' weight + neutral sans body; aggressive scale jump between the two.
